mentions.name: ChatFrom.io
mentions.description: A knowledge-base chatbot (ChatFrom.io): users upload their knowledge base and it answers questions using advanced RAG with hybrid search and reranking. It integrates with Stripe, Shopify, and other tools, and works on Telegram, Slack, and more. Free to start.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m based in Berlin and currently working on ChatFrom.io . You upload your knowledge base, and it uses advanced RAG with hybrid search and reranking to find answers when someone asks a question. It connects to Stripe, Shopify, and other tools, and works on Telegram, Slack, and more. Free to start.
